songWizard.queryHint: Enter the recording title. The artist is optional and helps find the right version.
songWizard.resultsHint: Select the right version and continue. If the original recording is missing, go back and add the artist or refine the title.
songWizard.noResults: No matching recording found. Your title and artist have been kept. Add a Spotify track link to continue.
songWizard.missingLink: No Spotify link was found. The selected recording details are kept — paste a track link to continue.
songWizard.proposedSourceHint: These are suggested Spotify links. Preview them and select the right link — it may lead to a different recording version.
songWizard.directSourceHint: These links are attached to the selected recording in MusicBrainz. Select the right link; you can check its preview.
songWizard.reviewHint: Check the title, artist and year of this recording version before saving the card.
songWizard.noAutoSearch: You can edit these details manually. To change the recording, go back to search.
songWizard.previewCandidate: Suggested track preview. Select its link if you want to use it on the card.
songWizard.queryUnavailable: Recordings could not be searched. Your entered details have been kept. Add a Spotify link and complete the card manually.
songWizard.linksUnavailable: Spotify links could not be loaded. The recording details are kept — you can paste your own link.
songWizard.selectRecording: Select a recording or manual entry to continue.
songWizard.selectSource: Select a Spotify link or choose to paste your own link.
songWizard.manualSource: I’ll paste my own Spotify link
songWizard.sourceHint: Paste a link to a specific track. If you do not have one, the button below opens Spotify search.
